name: Making language models and reasoning better with reinforcement learning
gist: Using reinforcement learning techniques to help large language models reason through problems step-by-step, improve their reasoning chains, or align their outputs with human preferences.
explain: Large language models can generate text, but they often make mistakes or stop reasoning too early. The problem is: a model trained just to predict the next word doesn't know when it's solving the problem right. It needs feedback that says 'yes, that reasoning chain was correct' or 'no, that answer is wrong.' Reinforcement learning can provide that feedback. Instead of asking a human to write the perfect answer for every task, researchers score each attempted solution — a chain of reasoning steps that led to a correct answer gets high score, a wrong answer gets low score. The model learns to repeat what gets high scores.

The trick is that language models think in sequences — one token (word chunk) at a time — and the reward for the whole chain comes only at the end. So the model has to learn which earlier steps contributed to the final success, not just copy the final answer. It's like learning to play chess by playing games and only knowing at the end whether you won, but having to remember which moves in the middle mattered. Papers in this area train models to generate reasoning chains step-by-step, then score the full chain, then adjust what the model learns to favor high-scoring chains.

This matters because it lets AI systems tackle harder problems. Instead of answering yes-or-no questions instantly, they can walk through multi-step math, trace logic, or plan actions. The reinforcement learning component keeps them from just memorizing text that looks like reasoning — it makes them solve the actual problem.

papers.contribution: Boosts a 7B model to 67.0% on Time-Dialog with 10.2% gain over 14B baseline, maintains robustness at 128k tokens where baselines collapse with 15% performance gain from rewards.

papers.title: Mirage or Method? How Model–Task Alignment Induces Divergent RL Conclusions
papers.contribution: Counterintuitive results arise only with strong model-task alignment; standard RL remains robust across settings while special techniques fail in harder regimes.

papers.title: Multi-Task GRPO: Reliable LLM Reasoning Across Tasks
papers.contribution: MT-GRPO achieves 16-28% improvement on worst-task performance over standard GRPO and 6% over DAPO, requiring 50% fewer steps to reach 50% worst-task accuracy in 3-task settings.

papers.title: Multivariate Distributional Reinforcement Learning Using Sliced Divergences
papers.contribution: Provides tractable multivariate distributional RL supporting Wasserstein, Cramér, and MMD divergences with theoretical contraction guarantees.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Policy Optimization in Contextual MDPs with General Offline Function Approximation
papers.contribution: Achieves regret bound with optimal dependence on state and action spaces, improving over prior state-of-the-art.

papers.title: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: The noisy-space objective provides a principled and effective basis for diffusion policy training, demonstrating strong results on D4RL and vision-based OGBench tasks.

papers.title: OPPO: Accelerating PPO-based RLHF via Pipeline Overlap
papers.contribution: OPPO accelerates PPO-based RLHF training by 1.8x-2.8x and improves GPU utilization by 1.4x-2.1x without compromising convergence.

papers.title: On Entropy Control in LLM-RL Algorithms
papers.contribution: AEnt outperforms baselines consistently across math reasoning benchmarks under different base models and datasets.

papers.title: On the Design of KL-Regularized Policy Gradient Algorithms for LLM Reasoning
papers.contribution: On AIME24 and AIME25 benchmarks, RPG-REINFORCE improves accuracy by up to +6 absolute percentage points over DAPO.

papers.title: On the Direction of RLVR Updates for LLM Reasoning: Identification and Exploitation
papers.contribution: In this work, we argue that the direction of updates is a more critical lens for understanding RLVR's effects, which can be captured by the signed, token-level log probability difference $\Delta\log p$ between the base and final RLVR models.

papers.title: On the Entropy Dynamics in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Derives entropy-discriminator clipping methods and provides unified interpretation of entropy-based RFT methods.

papers.title: On the Tension Between Optimality and Adversarial Robustness in Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: BARPO consistently outperforms vanilla ARPO, reconciling the theory-practice gap between robust and standard policy optimization.

papers.title: One-Way Policy Optimization for Self-Evolving LLMs
papers.contribution: Outperforms DAPO, OPD, and MOPD, enabling continuous self-evolution without reliance on external reference models.

papers.title: OpenHA: A Series of Open-Source Hierarchical Agentic Models in Minecraft
papers.contribution: OpenHA achieves state-of-the-art performance as an All-in-One generalist agent trained on diverse action spaces, outperforming strong specialized baselines on over 800 Minecraft tasks.

papers.title: Optimal Regret for Policy Optimization in Contextual Bandits
papers.contribution: First high-probability optimal regret bound for policy optimization in contextual bandits, bridging theory-practice gap.

papers.title: POLIA: Policy Optimization with Visual-Object-Level Intrinsic Advantage for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms open MLLMs and strong baselines on diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks with improved credit assignment.

papers.title: PRPO: Paragraph-level Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Deepfake Detection
papers.contribution: PRPO improves detection accuracy significantly and achieves the highest reasoning score of 4.55/5.0, substantially outperforming GRPO under test-time conditions.

papers.title: PS-PPO : Prefix-Sampling PPO for Critic-Free RLHF
papers.contribution: Achieves large reductions in training compute and peak GPU memory while maintaining accuracy comparable to full-trajectory critic-free baselines.

papers.title: Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates improved distributional fidelity, training stability, and competitive offline RL performance across analytically tractable MRPs, OGBench, and D4RL.

papers.title: Performative Policy Gradient: Optimality in Performative Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: PePG converges to performatively optimal policies that remain optimal under induced distribution shifts, extending prior work achieving only stability.

papers.title: PolicyFlow: Policy Optimization with Continuous Normalizing Flow in Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Integrates expressive CNF policies with PPO-style objectives without requiring full trajectory likelihood evaluation, achieving competitive or superior performance on diverse tasks.

papers.title: Polychromic Objectives for Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Improved success rates on BabyAI and Minigrid by reliably solving more environment configurations and achieving higher coverage in pass@n experiments.

papers.title: Predictive CVaR Q-learning
papers.contribution: Improves CVaR performance while maintaining stable and interpretable learning dynamics, with consistency proofs via Bellman optimality equation.

papers.title: Primal-Dual Policy Optimization for Adversarial Linear CMDPs
papers.contribution: First algorithm achieving sublinear regret and constraint violation bounds of O(K^3/4) for online finite-horizon adversarial linear CMDPs.

papers.title: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art proactive recommender systems on three real-world datasets.

papers.title: Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently
papers.contribution: Demonstrates inference-time compute separation between SFT and RLVR; shows RLVR learns location of difficult decisions enabling better compute allocation; reasoning traces distill to base models for efficient backtracking.

papers.title: Q-Flow: Stable and Expressive Reinforcement Learning with Flow-based Policy
papers.contribution: Q-Flow outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on OGBench by an average of 10.6 percentage points in offline learning while maintaining stability for online adaptation.

papers.title: QUATRO: Query-Adaptive Trust Region Policy Optimization for LLM Fine-tuning
papers.contribution: QUATRO shows stable training under increased policy staleness and aggressive learning rates on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks, maintaining well-controlled entropy.

papers.title: Quantile Advantage Estimation for Entropy-Safe Reasoning
papers.contribution: Stabilizes entropy, sparsifies credit assignment (80% responses receive zero advantage), and yields sustained pass@1 gains on Qwen3-8B/14B across AIME/AMC benchmarks.

papers.title: Quantum Robust Inner Minimization for Reinforcement Learning with Quadratic Speed-Up in Query Complexity
papers.contribution: QRIM achieves O(√|U|) query complexity versus classical O(|U|), validated through classical simulations and real quantum hardware execution.

papers.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
papers.contribution: Consistently improved input dependence and task performance across planning, math, navigation, and code execution through monitoring and mitigating template collapse.

papers.title: REA-RL: Reflection-Aware Online Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Reasoning
papers.contribution: Maintains or enhances performance while reducing inference costs by 36%, with methods effective by maintaining reflection for hard problems and reducing it for easy ones.

papers.title: REAL: Regression-Aware Reinforcement Learning for LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.contribution: Achieves +8.40 Pearson and +7.20 Spearman correlation gains over SFT baseline on Qwen3-32B with significantly better out-of-domain generalization.

papers.title: RLVMR: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Meta-Reasoning Rewards for Robust Long-Horizon Agents
papers.contribution: RLVMR achieves 83.6% success on ALFWorld's hardest unseen split and demonstrates improved reasoning quality with reduced redundant actions and enhanced error recovery.

papers.title: RN-D: Discretized Categorical Actors for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Substantially improves continuous-control performance achieving state-of-the-art results within on-policy RL by replacing Gaussian actors.

papers.title: Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT): Computing Natural Policy Gradients via Direct Backpropagation
papers.contribution: Matches or exceeds established natural-gradient methods across continuous and visual control benchmarks while remaining simple and compatible with various architectures.

papers.title: Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves substantial gains on mathematical reasoning across 7 LLM scales and 10 robotic control tasks, with particularly pronounced improvements on smaller models.

papers.title: Reasoning as Representation: Rethinking Visual Reinforcement Learning in Image Quality Assessment
papers.contribution: RALI achieves generalization performance comparable to reasoning-based models using less than 5% of parameters and inference time.

papers.title: Recurrent Structural Policy Gradient for Partially Observable Mean Field Games
papers.contribution: Achieves order-of-magnitude faster convergence than model-free RL while learning history-aware policies, introducing MFAX JAX framework for MFG research.

papers.title: Recursive Monte-Carlo Tree Search
papers.contribution: RMCTS matches or exceeds AlphaZero's MCTS-UCB quality in a tiny fraction of the time.

papers.title: Reevaluating Policy Gradient Methods for Imperfect-Information Games
papers.contribution: Finds that simple policy gradient methods outperform or match FP-, DO-, and CFR-based approaches on exploitability, challenging the assumption that complex algorithms are necessary.

papers.title: Refined Analysis of Entropy-Regularized Actor-Critic
papers.contribution: With exact critic matches sample complexity of deterministic policy gradient reaching epsilon-optimal solution with Õ(log(1/ε)) samples; identify importance of accurate critic learning.

papers.title: Regularized Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance with metric-agnostic guarantees for monotonic improvement until convergence.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
papers.contribution: Improves sample efficiency and final accuracy on scientific reasoning, tool use, and competitive programming; accelerates discovery on difficult tasks with 3x fewer attempts.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Action-Triggered Observations
papers.contribution: Derives ATST-LSVI-UCB achieving regret O-tilde(sqrt(K d^3 (1-gamma)^-3)) matching the known rate for linear MDPs with full observability.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards: GRPO's Loss, Dynamics, and Success Amplification
papers.contribution: Analysis proves GRPO amplifies the policy's probability of success, with a fixed point exceeding reference probability determined by regularization strength.

papers.title: Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves strong empirical performance at superior sample efficiency, wall-clock time, memory footprint, and hyperparameter robustness compared to state-of-the-art on-policy methods.

papers.title: Relative Value Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance on Atari benchmarks compared to standard PPO, demonstrating relative value estimation as an effective alternative.

papers.title: Reparameterization Flow Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: RFO achieves almost 2x reward improvement on challenging soft-body locomotion tasks compared to state-of-the-art baselines across rigid, soft bodies with state or visual inputs.

papers.title: Reparameterization Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: Maintains superior sample efficiency and consistently outperforms or achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks while addressing stability concerns.

papers.title: Representation-Based Exploration for Language Models: From Test-Time to Post-Training
papers.contribution: Achieves 50%+ improvement in verifier efficiency at inference-time and 3x improvement in post-training sample efficiency on AIME 2024, matching higher-sample performance with fewer evaluations.

papers.title: Rethinking Policy Diversity in Ensemble Policy Gradient in Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Outperforms SAPG, PBT, and PPO across dexterous manipulation tasks in both sample efficiency and final performance with structured exploratory behavior.

papers.title: Rethinking the Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves superior stability and efficiency compared to PPO with more robust foundation for RL-based LLM fine-tuning.

papers.title: Reuse your FLOPs: Scaling RL on Hard Problems by Conditioning on Very Off-Policy Prefixes
papers.contribution: PrefixRL reaches the same training reward 2x faster than the strongest baseline and increases final reward by 3x on hard reasoning problems.

papers.title: Reusing Trajectories in Policy Gradients Enables Fast Convergence
papers.contribution: Achieves O(epsilon^-1) sample complexity when reusing all available past trajectories, the best known rate for policy gradient methods.

papers.title: Revisiting Group Relative Policy Optimization: Insights into On-Policy and Off-Policy Training
papers.contribution: Shows off-policy GRPO either significantly outperforms or matches on-policy counterpart with improved efficiency and stability.

papers.title: Revisiting Regularized Policy Optimization for Stable and Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Two-Player Games
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior training efficiency compared to existing methods across five board games (Animal Shogi, Gardner Chess, Go, Hex, Othello) with novel convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Reward Redistribution for CVaR MDPs using a Bellman Operator on L-infinity
papers.contribution: Develops risk-averse value iteration and Q-learning with convergence guarantees and discretization error bounds, enabling practical CVaR-sensitive policy learning with effective performance-safety trade-offs.

papers.title: Reward and Guidance through Rubrics: Promoting Exploration to Improve Multi-Domain Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves average improvements of +7.0%, +5.4%, +8.4%, and +6.6% on mathematics, physics, chemistry, and general reasoning tasks with sustained exploration and superior pass@k performance.

papers.title: RiskPO: Risk-based Policy Optimization with Verifiable Reward for LLM Post-Training
papers.contribution: RiskPO achieves consistent improvements in mathematical reasoning, multi-modal reasoning, and code generation, surpassing GRPO on both Pass@1 and Pass@k metrics while alleviating entropy collapse.

papers.title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% of training FLOPs required by supervised fine-tuning, while improving scores on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%).

papers.title: SSVPO: Effective Step-Level Credit Assignment for RL Training of Language Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art RL methods with up to 11.6% accuracy gain, 18.1% token reduction, and 1.6x efficiency improvement across 7 benchmarks.

papers.title: Sample More to Think Less: Group Filtered Policy Optimization for Concise Reasoning
papers.contribution: Cuts length inflation by up to 85% across STEM and coding benchmarks while preserving accuracy, with ~30% end-to-end latency reduction and no loss of reasoning capability.

papers.title: Scalable Option Learning in High-Throughput Environments
papers.contribution: Achieves ~35x higher throughput compared to existing hierarchical methods and demonstrates positive scaling trends on NetHack surpassing flat agents.

papers.title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
papers.contribution: DreamGym substantially improves RL training and outperforms baselines by over 150% on non-RL-ready tasks like WebArena while matching GRPO/PPO using only synthetic data.

papers.title: Scaling Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Multistep Quasimetric Distances
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing GCRL methods on long-horizon tasks with up to 4000 steps and visual observations, and enables stitching in real-world robotic manipulation.

papers.title: Second-Order Smooth Planning with Optimal-Transport Bellman Smoothing
papers.contribution: Reduces oracle complexity from O(ε^-4) to O(ε^-3) with fixed OT parameters, improving sample efficiency while maintaining theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: See First, Reason Later: Mutual Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves 70.22% average accuracy on six vision-language reasoning benchmarks with 25% fewer complete trajectories than sampling 16 trajectories, using only 10 pre-samples with top-6 selection.

papers.title: Segment-Aligned Policy Optimization for Multi-Modal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms token-level and sequence-level methods with significant accuracy improvements and better training stability and value estimation consistency.

papers.title: Self-supervised Hierarchical Visual Reasoning with World Model
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art sample efficiency and parameter efficiency with a scalable hierarchical visual foresight architecture for online RL in dynamic environments.

papers.title: SetPO: Set-Level Policy Optimization for Diversity-Preserving LLM Reasoning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines in both Pass@1 and Pass@K across model scales and benchmarks.

papers.title: Shop-R1: Rewarding LLMs to Simulate Human Behavior in Online Shopping via Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 65% relative improvement over baselines in predicting real human behavior in online shopping environments.

papers.title: Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.contribution: Shrinkage baselines provably yield lower-variance policy-gradient estimators across algorithms and require no additional hyperparameters or computation.

papers.title: Shuffle-R1: Efficient RL framework for Multimodal Large Language Models via Data-centric Dynamic Shuffle
papers.contribution: Framework consistently outperforms strong RL baselines with minimal overhead across multiple reasoning benchmarks for MLLMs.

papers.title: Simplicial Embeddings Improve Sample Efficiency in Actor–Critic Agents
papers.contribution: Simplicial embeddings consistently improve sample efficiency and final performance on continuous and discrete control tasks without runtime cost.

papers.title: Slow-Fast Policy Optimization: Reposition-Before-Update for LLM Reasoning
papers.contribution: SFPO outperforms GRPO by up to 2.80 points on math reasoning benchmarks while achieving 4.93× fewer rollouts and 4.19× reduction in wall-clock time.

papers.title: Sparse but Critical: A Token-Level Analysis of Distributional Shifts in RLVR Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.contribution: The analysis reveals that RL fine-tuning induces sparse, targeted changes with only a small fraction of tokens exhibiting significant distributional divergence, with critical tokens essential for performance recovery.

papers.title: Spectral Bellman Method: Unifying Representation and Exploration in RL
papers.contribution: Learned representations enable structured exploration via Bellman-aligned covariance, improving performance on hard-exploration and long-horizon tasks.

papers.title: Spurious Rewards: Rethinking Training Signals in RLVR
papers.contribution: Shows 21.4% gain on MATH-500 with random rewards nearly matching 29.1% with ground truth; highlights model-dependent effectiveness requiring diverse validation.

papers.title: Stabilizing PPO via Latent-Space Regularization and KDE-Driven Exploration
papers.contribution: SPPO demonstrates consistent gains over PPO and recent PPO stabilization methods on standard continuous-control benchmarks with improved training stability.

papers.title: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Enable stable full-parameter RL for diffusion LLMs, achieving 6% improvement on MATH500 and 25.6% on AIME over prior baselines.

papers.title: Stable Asynchrony: Variance-Controlled Off-Policy RL for LLMs
papers.contribution: VCPO enables robustly stable asynchronous training across math and reasoning benchmarks even in highly off-policy regimes (128 steps), matching synchronous performance while delivering 2.5x speedup.

papers.title: Stackelberg Coupling of Online Representation Learning and Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Asymmetric bi-level optimization reduces bias and variance in value estimation across DQN variants with stable co-adaptation.

papers.title: Stochastic Minimum-Cost Reach-Avoid Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Algorithms converge almost surely to locally optimal policies with improved cost performance and consistently higher reach-avoid satisfaction rates.

papers.title: Stop Unnecessary Reflection: Training LRMs for Efficient Reasoning with Adaptive Reflection and Length Coordinated Penalty
papers.contribution: ARLCP reduces response length by 53.1% while improving accuracy by 5.8% for 1.5B models, and achieves 35.0% reduction for 7B models.

papers.title: Structured Reasoning for LLMs: A Unified Framework for Efficiency and Explainability
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms GRPO on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models through step-level reasoning optimization and sparse graph construction.

papers.title: Success-Conditioning as Policy Improvement: The Optimization Problem Solved by Imitating Success
papers.contribution: Shows success conditioning is conservative improvement operator that cannot degrade performance, with identity between relative improvement, policy change magnitude, and action-influence at every state.

papers.title: Synthesizing Multimodal Verifiable Game Data to Boost VLMs' General Reasoning
papers.contribution: Training solely on GameQA improves VLMs' out-of-domain generalization, demonstrating that video games provide valuable multimodal and verifiable rewards for enhancing VLMs' general reasoning abilities.

papers.title: TGPO: Efficient Policy Optimization through Sequence Anchor and Information Gating
papers.contribution: Consistently enhances learning efficiency across seven mathematical reasoning datasets, improving gradient utilization while maintaining stable optimization.

papers.title: TIPS: Turn-level Information-Potential Reward Shaping for Search-Augmented LLMs
papers.contribution: TIPS consistently outperforms GRPO/PPO baselines with Qwen-2.5 7B improving Exact Match by 11.8% and F1 by 13.6%, substantially improving training stability across seven QA benchmarks.

papers.title: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization
papers.contribution: Improves judge win-rates, faithfulness, and calibration over DPO on mathematical reasoning, QA, summarization, and dialogue; matches or exceeds PPO on reasoning tasks while maintaining simplicity.

papers.title: The Choice of Divergence: A Neglected Key to Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward
papers.contribution: DPH-RL improves both in-domain Pass@1 and Pass@k scores and effectively prevents catastrophic forgetting on out-of-domain tasks with higher training efficiency.

papers.title: The Role of Target Update Frequencies in Q-Learning
papers.contribution: Results show constant update schedules are suboptimal with logarithmic sample complexity overhead, and optimal frequency decreases geometrically during learning, enabling principled hyperparameter selection.

papers.title: Time-Consistent Robust Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning via a Bellman–Isaacs Weight-Adversary Recursion
papers.contribution: Develops BR-K evaluation testing policies against independent best-response adversaries, improving WRR under step-wise opponents.

papers.title: TimeSearch-R: Adaptive Temporal Search for Long-Form Video Understanding via Self-Verification Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: The approach achieves substantial improvements on temporal search benchmarks including Haystack-LVBench and Haystack-Ego4D for long-form video understanding.

papers.title: Tournament Style RL: Stabilizing Policy Optimization on Non Verifiable Problems
papers.contribution: TSRL improves average win-rate by 43.8 points over base model and 22.8 points over strongest baseline, scaling with anchors and remaining robust to judge noise.

papers.title: Towards Achieving Optimal Strong Regret and Constraint Violation via Computationally Efficient Model-free RL
papers.contribution: Achieves near-optimal O-tilde(sqrt(K)) strong regret and constraint violation with Slater, and O-tilde(K^3/4) without it, the first sublinear result without Slater.

papers.title: Tree Search for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates tree-structured trajectory equivalence to step-level direct preference learning; outperforms chain-based RL across 11 datasets and 3 QA task types.

papers.title: Tricks or Traps? A Deep Dive into RL for LLM Reasoning
papers.contribution: A minimalist combination of two RL techniques unlocks critic-free policy learning with vanilla PPO, consistently improving performance and surpassing GRPO and DAPO.

papers.title: Trust-Region Adaptive Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: TRAPO consistently surpasses SFT, RL, and SFT-then-RL baselines plus recent state-of-the-art on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: Unbiased Principles, Robust Rewards
papers.contribution: Recent Generative Reward Models (GRMs) improve interpretability by producing natural-language rationales and task-specific evaluation principles

papers.title: VITA: Zero-Shot Value Functions via Test-Time Adaptation of Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: Generalizes from single training environment to diverse out-of-distribution tasks, environments, and embodiments; value estimates enable reward shaping in offline RL with Meta-World performance exceeding fuzzy-logic rewards.

papers.title: Video-OPD: Efficient Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models for Temporal Video Grounding via On-Policy Distillation
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms GRPO with substantially faster convergence and lower computational cost while achieving 70.22% average accuracy, establishing on-policy distillation as effective alternative to conventional RL.

papers.title: VideoSEG-O3: A Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
papers.contribution: Achieves advanced performance across 8 benchmarks, excelling in long-horizon and complex reasoning tasks.

papers.title: WS-GRPO: Weakly-Supervised Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Rollout-Efficient Reasoning
papers.contribution: Substantially reduces rollout length while maintaining accuracy on reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: What You Think is What You See: Driving Exploration in VLM Agents via Visual-Linguistic Curiosity
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness across agentic tasks, showing that aligning linguistic predictions with visual reality enables solving complex or sparse-reward tasks.

papers.title: When Greedy Wins: Emergent Exploitation Bias in Meta-Bandit LLM Training
papers.contribution: Shows agents trained with RL/SFT match UCB/Thompson Sampling performance with robust generalization but reveal early catastrophic failure from exploitative bias.
